control_method: Compare every reported non-time counter on successful common solves (missing numeric counters treated as zero). Scan comparison additionally excludes equality diagnostics. Counter agreement does not establish identical traces. Frozen-source controls use prior8d84fdca candidate-native/enabled-native rows, not fresh baseline timings.

reference.policy: Prior Z3 answers reused only for SHA-identical inputs; one fresh cvc5 answer closes two SAT rows where prior Z3 timed out. Prior Z3 timing curve unchanged.

counter_limitations: Timeout counters cover partial prefixes; missing values are not zero. Fallback counters increment after retry returns, so an unfinished retry can still report zero. State counters may describe the complete retry rather than cumulative objects.
